reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-FP — The sink expression writes `encodeForHTML(new String(input))` to the response. Although `input` is derived from user parameters (`param` from `request.getParameterMap()`), the application applies `encodeForHTML` immediately before rendering. The resolved sink value is the sanitized HTML entity representation of the input, which excludes executable scripts/XSS payloads. As per dual-gate calibration, since the resolved sink value is not attacker-controlled (due to encoding), the alert is a false positive.
